title: J062--Replace street light pole concrete bases.
description_text: RFQ Replace existing streetlight pole concrete bases for St. Cloud VA Health Care System. This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation information that is being requested. Solicitation number 36C26326Q0712 is issued as a request for quotation (RFQ). This procurement is a Small Business Set-Aside. Prospective offerors must be registered and current in the System for Award Management (SAM) database at time of offer to the Government (https://www.sam.gov). Additional requirements are listed within the attached solicitation document. Site Visit Information: May 26, 2026, at 10:00AM CDT at Facilities Management Office Building 3, Second Floor St. Cloud VA Health Care System 4801 Veterans Drive St. Cloud, MN 56303 Conference Room 207C POC: Mayda I. Vazquez Velez Phone number: (320) 252-1670 x 7785 Technical questions on this solicitation are due via e-mail only to Safa Shleiwet, contract specialist at safa.shleiwet@va.gov no later than 12:00 PM Central Day Time (CDT), 05/27/2026. Responses are due to the Contracting Office by 5:00 PM CDT, 06/01/2026. Responses are required to be emailed to safa.shleiwet@va.gov prior to the solicitation closing date and time. It is the responsibility of the offeror to ensure their quote is received in its entirety by the Contracting Officer before the solicitation closing.
